newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-BACK INJURY RULES NZ'S DOULL OUT OF CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BACK INJURY RULES NZ'S DOULL OUT OF CUP.

text.p: New Zealand's senior strike bowler Simon Doull has been forced out of this month's Independence Cup limited overs cricket tournament in India because of a stress fracture of the lower back.
New Zealand Cricket said Doull, 27, had been advised to rest for a period of up to seven weeks, ruling him out of the quadrangular tournament which starts next week.
Doull was voted New Zealand's player of the year last month for a season in which he captured 31 wickets in seven tests against Pakistan, England and Sri Lanka.
A replacement bowler for Doull has yet to be named.
New Zealand leave for India on Sunday where they will play a series of one-day matches against the Indian hosts, Pakistan and World Cup holders Sri Lanka.
Their first game is a day-night fixture against Pakistan on Friday, May 9.
